name: Admin Settings — profile, appearance, account, management

planSteps.description: Enter phone number 923001234567 and click Send Code

The Settings page loads showing profile section with avatar, name, role, phone, Edit button, Appearance section (Light Mode, Language), Account section (Change PIN, Notifications, Activity Log, Device info, App Version), Management section (Employees, Companies, Inventory, Reports), and Sign Out button
The PIN change page opens with a numeric keypad for entering a new PIN
Go back and click the 'Notifications' button
The Notifications page opens showing a list of business notifications
